title: Meta-Skill Routing Table
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI Agent Skills
Meta-Skills
Progressive Disclosure
Skill Routing
description: Clickable left-to-right flowchart showing how the microsim-generator meta-skill uses a trigger keyword table to route a request to exactly one on-demand guide. The learner types or picks a request; the matching route, guide, and table row are highlighted, and ambiguous or unmatched requests are explained.

learningObjectives: Demonstrate how a meta-skill's routing table matches a request's trigger keywords to exactly one on-demand guide.
Predict which guide a request will load from the keywords it contains.
Rewrite an ambiguous request so that it routes to a single guide.
prerequisites: Knows what a skill is and how an agent chooses one from its description
Has read the definitions of meta-skill, skill routing table, and on-demand guide loading

controls.label: Request
controls.description: A MicroSim request of up to 90 characters; Enter routes it

controls.label: Route
controls.description: Matches the request against the trigger keyword table and highlights the result

controls.label: Examples
controls.description: Six example requests, including one ambiguous request

controls.label: Flowchart node
controls.description: Each of the eight nodes has a Mermaid click directive that shows its definition; guide nodes also highlight their edge and table row

assumptions: The guide with the most trigger keywords found in the request wins
The keywords are the real trigger keywords for these five guides in the microsim-generator skill
limitations: Shows five of the skill's guides, not all of them
The real meta-skill is interpreted by a language model that weighs the whole request rather than counting keywords

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: The learner supplies requests and observes which single guide each one loads
keyQuestions: Which keywords in the request caused this guide to load?
What happens to the guides that were not matched?
commonMisconceptions: A meta-skill loads all of its guides whenever it is triggered
A meta-skill performs the task itself
assessmentOpportunities: Rewrite an ambiguous request two ways so that each version routes to a different single guide
